profile.name: tinycrops
profile.tagline: self-directed research on machines that model themselves — and can show it to someone else
profile.blurb: Two years of unpaid, self-directed work on one question, run on a five-machine cluster of secondhand hardware. Local model serving, embedding stores, ASR and voice, and measured experiments — including the ones that failed. Everything below is public and reproducible.

selected.title: Mercenary Warrant price-check — upstream feature
selected.note: Built a price-check path for a new item class in a trading tool with a large user base, ported from an upstream issue and verified end to end against live trade data.

selected.title: The Realness Ladder
selected.note: Measured whether ASCII art, rasterized and passed through img2img, moves monotonically toward photographic 'realness' in a shared embedding space. It does, across a nine-subject corpus, and identity survives the whole ladder.

selected.title: Geometry as Judge
selected.note: Asks whether the geometry of an embedding space can stand in for a human rater. Includes the negative results — where the geometry disagrees with people, and why that matters more than where it agrees.

selected.title: OKF Commons — compressed research memory
selected.note: Turns years of saved browser tabs into a queryable knowledge base with bidirectional provenance, so every claim traces back to the source that produced it.

selected.title: ARC orientation workbench
selected.note: A corpus-level workbench for ARC-AGI built on one primitive — nuisance, group action, harmonic invariants. Retrieval accuracy went from 28% to 46% under that framing.

selected.title: Topics you can hire me to teach
selected.note: What I can be hired to explain, and to whom.
